subject: Conversion schedule, MAP milestones & credit handoff for Elevate Labs
messages:
From: Sam Cho <sam.cho@elevatelabs.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@elevatelabs.com
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Initial: MAP & credits — request to formalize schedule

Vanessa,

Thanks for the demo earlier this week — the team was impressed with the latency and the dedicated routing options. Before we move to a committed pilot, procurement asked that we capture the mutual action plan and the financial handoff for credits in writing. High-level ask below:

- We want a 60-day evaluation starting July 1, with a 30% ramp target at day 30 and production readiness by day 60.
- Can Redwood allocate a $20k pilot credit that vests in two tranches: $12k at MAP sign-off and $8k when we hit the day-30 ramp target?
- If we convert to a 12-month committed plan within 45 days of day 60, we request a conversion discount (three-tier suggestion in body).

Attached is a draft MAP (PDF) we scribbled. Procurement is ready to issue a PO once we formalize milestone definitions and confirm DocuSign path.

Quick Q: can credits be applied to first invoice at onboarding, or do they need to be consumed during the evaluation?

Appreciate your help — Sam

--
Sam Cho
Head of AI Programs | Elevate Labs

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@elevatelabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: MAP & credits — request to formalize schedule

Sam — thanks, and glad the demo resonated. High level ok from our side; a few details to ensure mutual clarity:

- Credit structure: Redwood can commit to a $20,000 pilot credit applied to usage invoices. We typically allow credits to be applied to the pilot invoices during evaluation, but with a PO we can reserve the credit and apply any leftover at onboarding invoice per your preference.
- Proposed vesting: $12k on MAP acceptance (signature), $8k released upon reaching the agreed day-30 KPI (ramp metric below).
- Conversion discount: we can offer a stepped discount depending on commit size: 10% for 6-month 100k token commit, 15% for 12-month 250k token commit, 20% for >12-month strategic commits. Exact bands are negotiable.

Karthik, can you confirm the KPIs we should list for the day-30 ramp acceptance (latency SLA, throughput, and success rates)? Marissa — I’ll need a clean SOW and pricing rows to attach to the MAP PDF so procurement can PO against it.

Sam — if those terms are acceptable I can send an updated MAP + SOW and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Sam Cho <sam.cho@elevatelabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial: MAP & credits — request to formalize schedule

Sam — quick technical acceptance criteria suggestions for the MAP (day-30 ramp):

- Latency: 95th percentile < 220ms for 512-token requests during steady-state windows (10:00–16:00 PT).
- Throughput: sustained 50 concurrent requests with median latency < 180ms (baseline test harness attached in SOW).
- Quality gate: prompt-based evals (internal eval suite) must show no more than a 5% regression on the baseline accuracy tasks compared to your pilot baseline.
- Observability: Redwood debug hooks enabled and daily cost/latency dashboard shared for the evaluation window.

We can add an early-fail clause: if latency or throughput targets are missed by >20% at day-30, Redwood will provide an extra $2k credit as a remediation addendum.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Sam Cho <sam.cho@elevatelabs.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP & credits — draft SOW and commercial rows

Sam / Vanessa — attaching a cleaned SOW (SOW_Elevate_v0.2.docx) and the MAP PDF with commercial rows populated. Key commercial points:

- Pilot credit: $20,000 reserved against usage; invoicing note: invoice 1 will show gross usage and a credit line item. Unused credit can be applied to month-1 onboarding invoice if conversion is signed within 45 days post-pilot.
- Billing & PO: Procurement can issue PO to Redwood for the pilot credit; PO number will be referenced on the invoice.
- Conversion tiers (examples): 12-mo 250k token commit -> 15% discount, 18-mo 400k -> 18% discount, 24-mo 800k -> 22% discount.
- Cancellation: no penalty for not converting, but credits are non-refundable.

If that looks good I’ll prepare a DocuSign envelope with MAP + SOW and a short acceptance checkbox for the ramp KPI. Sam, you can route the DocuSign to procurement once signed.

-Marissa
Senior Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

[Attachment references: SOW_Elevate_v0.2.docx, Elevate_MAP_v1.pdf]

From: Procurement <procurement@elevatelabs.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:42:00 -0700
Subject: PO for pilot credit — PO #45019

Hi Marissa / Vanessa,

Attached is PO #45019 for $20,000 to reserve the pilot credit. Please confirm billing name and where to send the invoice. We prefer invoice referencing the PO and a net-30 payment term.

Also — please include the MAP PDF as an appendix to the PO so we have a single packet for internal approvals. Once we receive the DocuSign envelope we will sign and route.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Elevate Labs
[Attachment reference: PO_45019.pdf]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Sam Cho <sam.cho@elevatelabs.com>, Procurement <procurement@elevatelabs.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO for pilot credit — PO #45019 (DocuSign + next steps)

Thank you — confirmed receipt of PO #45019. Next steps:

1) Marissa will send DocuSign with MAP_v1 + SOW_Elevate_v0.2. Please sign the MAP acceptance checkbox and return.
2) Once signed we will apply $12k credit immediately to the upcoming pilot invoice and hold $8k pending day-30 KPI verification.
3) Karthik will post the test harness and onboarding checklist by Tue EOD; we suggest scheduling a 90-minute onboarding call within 48 hours of the signed MAP.

A few housekeeping items: billing name should be "Elevate Labs, Inc." and invoices to accounts-payable@elevatelabs.com (net-30). Our invoice will reference PO #45019.

Sam — happy to expedite the DocuSign today. Marissa — please confirm envelope sent and let me know if legal needs to be looped for minimal redlines (we typically accept standard PO + MAP language).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachments sent: Elevate_MAP_v1.pdf, SOW_Elevate_v0.2.docx]
